verdict.rationale: iTerm2 is a local macOS terminal with an optional AI plugin that sends data to external LLM providers, so data residency is a fair question for it. The evidence documents no feature for choosing a storage region or residency. A community post notes that the AI API URL can be changed under Advanced settings, but that is a user-side workaround for picking an endpoint, not a documented residency control, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
